organization_type: cold-chain logistics provider for frozen food (synthetic)
organization_goal: keep every temperature-controlled shipment within its specified range

kpis.text: Shipments within range for the whole journey
Cold shipments with a continuous temperature log

tasks: Stream logger readings to the monitoring service
Alert the duty supervisor on an excursion
Quarantine affected goods pending a release decision
constraints: Goods with an unresolved excursion cannot be released

contribution_values.element: Quarantine affected goods pending a release decision

rational_statements.text: A release decision by the Quality Manager is the control that turns a detected excursion into a safe outcome.

conflicts_and_resolutions.conflict: automatic release would speed dispatch but bypass quality review
conflicts_and_resolutions.resolution: automatic release only for excursions under 15 minutes and 2 degrees; all others need the Quality Manager
